bounds.domain: One already-owned process group, one signal result, and one fresh inspection with six possible classifications.
bounds.scope: Darwin EPERM is ignored only after fresh inspection finds no live member. Live, failed, malformed, and empty inspections retain explicit failure. Group discovery, PID reuse, whole-tree reaping, Windows and non-Darwin signal semantics remain outside this projection.

assumptions: Weak fairness of settle assumes that the OS signal and process-table inspection eventually return success or failure. No wall-clock deadline or eventual process exit is proved.
